director.text: Namaste Riya, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher. Aaj cricket pizza jaise equal shares mein fractions dekhenge—tumhe cricket mein batting pasand hai ya bowling?
haan
Haan, Riya—batting ya bowling, dono cricket ke parts hain. Socho ek paratha chaar equal pieces mein baanta; ek piece ko kya kahenge?
step by step samjhao
Theek hai, dheere chalenge. Pehle: shape ko barabar parts mein baanto. Agar 2 equal parts hon, ek part ko kya kahenge?
chhota bolo
Theek hai, Riya. 2 equal parts mein ek part half hota hai. 3 equal parts mein ek part kya hoga?
pehle picture dikhao
Riya, ek poora board 3 barabar parts mein hai; unmein 1 part rangaa hua hai. Total parts kitne hain?
pata nahi
Koi baat nahi. Chalo, isko ek chhote step mein saath mein dekhte hain.
kuch aur baat karte hain
Haan Riya, lesson ek minute ruk sakta hai. Kis baare mein baat karni hai—cricket, cartoons, ya kuch aur?
cricket ke baare mein
Cricket mein batting ya bowling, tumhe kya zyada interesting lagta hai? Phir fraction wala chhota step karenge.
director.card: Khaali jagah bharo: 1/3 means 1 of ___ equal groups.

director.text: hindi mein batao
Theek hai, ab Hindi mein. Riya, cricket mein tumhe ballebaazi ya gendbaazi zyada achchi lagti hai?
director.card: Khaali jagah bharo: 1/3 means 1 of ___ equal groups.

director.text: mujhe khud try karne do
Theek hai, Riya—pehle tum khud try karo. Batao: ek-teesra hissa, 1 barabar group mein se kul kitne groups?
director.card: Khaali jagah bharo: 1/3 means 1 of ___ equal groups.

director.text: bye
Theek hai, Riya—tum chun sakti ho: aage badhein, chhota break lein, ya aaj rok dein. Tumhari kya choice hai?
